about_the_game:
You will play as the Commander of the Missile Division in the midst of World War III.
In a system where budgets are slashed and trust is collapsing, only by completing a series of high-risk missions can you secure funding and prevent the Missile Division from being dissolved.
Take control of your missiles, follow the pulse of electronic music, weave through enemy barrages and advanced defenses, and strike your targets with precision.
Beyond the battlefield, you must manage resources, develop new weapons, and upgrade equipment—fighting for the very survival of your division, holding the last line in a war that has turned into entertainment.

1️⃣ Rhythm-Driven Missile Control

In Ballistic Beats, music isn’t just background—it’s the commander of the battlefield.
Follow the rhythm of pounding electronic tracks, switch between three lanes with split-second timing, dodge deadly obstacles, and fire your missiles at the perfect moment.

  • Each track is a “battlefield performance,” where your inputs directly determine victory or defeat.

  • Explosions sync with the beat, blending roars of impact with basslines into an absurd symphony of war.

  • Difficulty escalates from tutorial-like rhythm drills to relentless electronic onslaughts, pushing both your reflexes and focus to the limit.

2️⃣ Missile & Budget Management

Wars are not only fought with weapons, but also on the budget sheets.
As Commander, every resource allocation could mean survival—or collapse:

  • Missile Inventory: Different missile types have unique capabilities—use them wisely.

  • Warehouses & Upgrades: Expand your storage, enhance the rhythm barrage system, and prepare for the next high-risk strike.

  • Funding Battles: Missions earn money, but rival departments and watchful superiors are always competing for the same resources.

  • Strategy & Trade-offs: Will you gamble on experimental warheads, or steadily invest in a reliable stockpile? Every choice comes at a cost.

3️⃣ Story & Dialogue

The narrative of Ballistic Beats unfolds against the backdrop of World War III.

  • You are not a celebrated hero, but a commander struggling to keep his division alive under shrinking budgets and eroding trust.

  • Before and after every mission, you’ll interact with your secretary, engineers, rivals, and even the President.

  • Dialogue shifts in tone—formal and tense in crises, sarcastic and sharp in calmer moments.

  • Your decisions will shape relationships and the tone of the war effort, but no one truly escapes from its grasp.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 345 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: As Missile Division Commander in WWIII, complete high-risk missions to save your unit. Dodge defenses, strike to the beat, and manage weapons and budgets to survive an entertainment-driven war.
